`helloworld.pdf` is an unmodified public PDF.js example from Mozilla:
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/master/examples/learning/helloworld.pdf

Licensed under Apache 2.0; see LICENSE.pdfjs. It contains only public test content, no investment records. Browser tests run in fresh, isolated contexts.

`mts-columns.js` and `mts-rows.js` contain the two extracted text orders observed in MTS statements. References have been replaced; personal headers, account/tax numbers, names, PDF passwords and the private PDF are excluded. Automated browser tests use fresh, isolated contexts.
